label_exposure: Evaluator knew selection roles; fresh observer was given only coded views and neutral target locators before its raw observations were frozen. Role map was not sent to observer.
control_gate: FAIL: C199.L02.T21 / A10 expected L but observer abstained with F1 unclear. No retuning or example replacement.
transfer_gate: NOT ACCEPTED: primary control gate failed. Three transfer observations described only; C328.L4W3.B01 / A02 also abstained.
target_observation: A06 classified L from closed pointed contour; no expected target family.
negative_result: Fixed stem/foot-versus-leaf criteria with this observer and these windows did not reproduce all canonical expectations and cannot support a card330 class upgrade.
cause_limit: Failure may involve feature overlap, contour junction visibility, approximate locators or observer judgment. Not proof that the frozen key is wrong, nor a source-accuracy estimate.
additional_limits: All source pixels were previously available to planners/earlier readers; procedural concealment is not global blinding.
The target rectangle and separability judgments are unverified geometrical proposals; no traced physical segmentation.
Observed matches to saved proposed labels are not ground-truth accuracy. Small purposive examples are not independent repeated trials.
No new plaintext added; A003 loop and IV/II were not tested.
concrete_required_data: Independent stroke-level annotation of canonical C199.L02.T21 and cross-card C328.L4W3.B01 plus C330.L01W03B05, retaining full neighbor context and hiding plaintext during annotation.
A genuinely higher-resolution independent scan/capture of those glyph contexts could resolve the upper junction/stem ownership; enlarging the same JPEG adds no ink evidence.
For any revised class criterion, calibrate on a larger declared development corpus, then freeze it and test on separately chosen unseen examples; do not reuse these ten as a fresh holdout.

summary_field_definitions.expectation_matches: Decision matches saved predeclared expectation; not ground-truth accuracy.
summary_field_definitions.N_decisions: All N decisions, including expected outside-binary negative controls and uncertainty abstentions.
summary_field_definitions.unexpected_abstentions: N where the predeclared expected decision was S or L.
